concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-mobilepay-android-drop-in]] — 2026-09-15 MobilePay Android Drop-in add-on for existing Sessions (Checkout API v68+) and Advanced redirect flows, with live-only normal-payment testing and a separate experimental `/payments` payout-token route.
warnings: Only the Advanced section explicitly states redirect action handling; the Sessions section routes to its base guide.
The payout token flag is `enablePayout` in prose and `enablePayOut` in the curl annotation; sample requests omit required token fields.
TEST endpoint and payout-test app instructions do not establish ordinary MobilePay TEST payment support.
